title: Foundations & Model Mechanics
summary: Treat the model as a probabilistic software component: what you pay for, how a token is chosen, how context shapes behaviour, and how to force machine-readable output.

title: Knowledge Grounding & RAG
summary: Embed, chunk, index and retrieve your own data, then ground answers in it with reranking, citations and hallucination checks.

title: Tool Use & Agentic Systems
summary: Let models call tools safely, speak MCP, run bounded control loops, remember across sessions and coordinate with other agents.

title: Model Customization & Post-Training
summary: Know when prompting stops being enough, then curate data, fine-tune with LoRA/QLoRA, align with preferences and distil into cheaper models.

title: Production, LLMOps & Security
summary: Prove quality with evals, see every hop with traces, cut latency and cost, and defend against prompt injection and data leakage.
